requirements_summary: Need a reproducible model pinning strategy for code completions: immutable model identifiers, tokenizer+vocab locking, quantization profile recording, and a per-suggestion audit trail. Must support streaming results, per-route rollouts/canaries, and human-in-the-loop eval gates for quality guardrails.
poC_details: Scope: 2-week canary on Dedicated pool with 50 internal engineers using VSCode plugin
Goals: validate p95 latency <150ms, no >5% drop in acceptance rate vs current baseline, reproducible replay of 1000 historical sessions
Deliverables: latency report, acceptance/hallucination metrics, reproducibility checklist, patch to tokenizer mapping tool
Success criteria: pass automated eval gates and <=5 manual review flags during canary
rollout_plan: Stage 0: lab validation — deterministic replay of stored requests against pinned model artifacts
Stage 1: internal canary (50 devs) — 2 weeks, metric alarms for p50/p95/p99 and acceptance rate
Stage 2: staged public beta — 500+ users, incrementally increase traffic 10% -> 25% -> 50%
Stage 3: GA with rollout policy that pins per-customer model version and fallback to stable family on mismatch
Policy notes: automatic rollback if model fails eval gates; canary traffic mirrored to stable model for live diffing
eval_gates: Automated: token-level divergence threshold vs baseline, compilation success rate, end-to-end unit tests (lint+build) on generated code
Human: sampling of 1% suggestions for manual QA; block release if >3% flagged for safety/incorrectness
Operational: p99 latency SLO, memory/kv-cache growth check, cost-per-1M-tokens within expected band
metrics_and_sla: Primary metrics: suggestion acceptance rate, edit-distance to final file, build-pass rate of generated snippets
Latency targets: p50 <50ms, p95 <150ms, p99 <300ms for single-line completions
Throughput: sustained 200 RPS for their Dedicated pool; burst to 1200 RPS during heavy internal events
SLA ask: 99.9% uptime for Dedicated, 99th-percentile latency guarantee for pinned routes
technical_questions: How does Redwood guarantee immutability of a pinned model artifact (hash+metadata)?
Can we pin tokenizer/vocab separately from model weights? Need deterministic tokenizer mapping for historical replays.
Is there a way to export the exact runtime config (kernels, quantization flags) used for a given suggestion?
Support for per-customer cached prefixes and how cache warming affects reproducibility?
Can Redwood generate a reproducibility manifest that we keep alongside user session logs?
